# raff_volume (Resource)

Manages a Raff block storage volume.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume display name.
- `size` (Number) Size in GB. Updates trigger an in-place resize (must be larger than current).
- `volume_type` (String) Storage class. One of: `nvme`.

### Optional

- `filesystem_type` (String) Filesystem type for first attach (Linux only). Defaults to ext4.
- `region` (String) Region. Defaults to the project's default region.
- `vm_id` (String) VM UUID to attach this volume to. Updates trigger detach/reattach.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `price_per_hour` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
